entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: P.s. Katrisarai, Tehsil Katrisarai, Dist. Nalanda, Bihar (Lodged In Dist. Jail, Churu)

----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp  ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Jaipal Singh For Respondent(s) : Mr. Urja Ram Kalbi, P.P.
 HON'BLE DR. JUSTICE NUPUR BHATI Order 08/05/2025 1.

The instant bail application has been filed by petitioner under Section 483 B.N.S.S. in connection with F.I.R. No.111/2021 dated 27.02.2021 registered at Police Station Sardarshahar, District Churu for the offences under Sections 420, 467, 468 & 120-B of IPC.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the co- accused Sushil Kumar and Ramesh Kumar have already been enlarged on bail by the co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 26.03.2021 passed in S.B. Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.4283/2021.

entities.text: S.B. Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.4283/2021
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: He also submits that the other co-accused Sameer Raj @ Tinku has already been enlarged on bail by the co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 20.07.2023 passed in S.B. Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.8020/2023.

entities.text: S.B. Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.8020/2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text:
Learned counsel further submits that the petitioner is in judicial custody in connection with the above offences, which are [2025:RJ-JD:22348] (2 of 2) [CRLMB-5429/2025]
exclusively triable by Magistrate and the petitioner's name is also not present in the FIR.
He therefore prays to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

3. Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor opposes the bail application, however, is not in a position to Anand Kumar vs State Of Rajasthan (2025:Rj-Jd:22348) on 8 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/105169566/
1 refute that the above named co-accused persons have already been enlarged on bail and the offences against the present petitioner are triable by Magistrate.

entities.text: Anand Kumar vs State Of Rajasthan (2025:Rj-Jd:22348)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Considering the arguments advanced by the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor, the case is exclusively triable by the court of Magistrate and no useful purpose would be served by keeping the present petitioner behind the bars for further period till disposal of the case and also looking to the possibility that the trial may take long time to conclude, this Court deems it just and proper to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

5. Accordingly, the bail application is allowed and it is ordered that the accused-petitioner Anand Kumar S/o Sunil Kumar, arrested in relation to F.I.R. No.111/2021 dated 27.02.2021 registered at Police Station Sardarshahar, District Churu, shall be enlarged on bail provided he furnishes a personal bond in sum of Rs.50,000/- with two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Judge for his appearance before the Court concerned on all the dates of hearing as and when called upon to do so.
